theme.title: Heat vs Mavericks, twice
theme.subtitle: 2006 and 2011 Finals
theme.recap: Dwyane Wade carried Miami past Dallas in 2006; five years later Dirk Nowitzki's Mavericks took the rematch.

questions.prompt: Down 2–0 in the 2006 Finals, how many points did Dwyane Wade score to win Game 3?
questions.note: 42 with 13 rebounds, rallying Miami from 13 down.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Led by Dwyane Wade's 42 points and 13 rebounds, the Heat rallied from a 13-point deficit

questions.prompt: Dwyane Wade was 2006 Finals MVP. What did he average?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Averaging 34.7 points per game in the series

questions.prompt: In Game 4 of the 2006 Finals, Miami held Dallas to how many fourth-quarter points?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Miami held Dallas to just seven points in the fourth quarter

questions.prompt: Across all six fourth quarters of the 2011 Finals, how many points did LeBron James score?
questions.context: 2011 NBA Finals · six games vs Dallas

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: He also scored just eight points throughout all six fourth quarters in the series.

questions.prompt: Dallas won Game 2 of the 2011 Finals after trailing by how many points?
questions.note: 15, then the biggest Finals comeback since a 24-point rally.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The Mavs' 15-point comeback was the biggest in an NBA Finals game since the 24-point comeback
